info.title: SPGP Pass Request API
info.description: Bearer-only user and administrator interfaces. See pass-request-api.md for external OAuth resource configuration and explicit account linking.

servers.description: Replace with the configured SPGP resource origin

get.summary: List pass requests with bounded pagination. User access always lists only your own requests.
get.description: Requires admin:pass-requests:read. The linked local account must also be an SPGP administrator.

200.description: Operation completed; records use a data envelope, lists include pagination meta, and bulk actions return a count.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, expired, or unlinked bearer token. WWW-Authenticate identifies protected-resource metadata.

403.description: Insufficient OAuth scope, ownership, administrator permission, or disallowed browser origin.
